description: NaYF₄ crystallizes in the trigonal P3 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are three shorter (2.26 Å) and three longer (2.30 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted octahedral geometry to six F atoms. There are three shorter (2.25 Å) and three longer (2.38 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.52 Å. There are three inequivalent Y sites. In the first Y site, Y is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Y-F bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.37 Å. In the second Y site, Y is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Y-F bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.35 Å. In the third Y site, Y is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Y-F bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.32 Å. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to one Na and three Y atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNaY₃ tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded to two Na and two Y atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra. In the third F site, F is bonded to two Na and two Y atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra. In the fourth F site, F is bonded to two Na and two Y atoms to form distorted FNa₂Y₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with thirteen FNa₂Y₂ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent FNa₂Y₂ trigonal pyramids, edges with four FNaY₃ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent FNa₂Y₂ trigonal pyramids.
